title: Supplied root aliases are discarded before the final identity check
detail: Constructor resolves worktree, review, and root_manifest immediately. The root-manifest private fixture retargets the supplied symlink from one.json to two.json with identical bytes. The exact final input loop passes because the recorded input_path is already one.json. Direct read(alias) control rejects the same retarget. Worktree/review roots have the same static loss; only root-manifest retarget was dynamically probed.
minimal_remedy: Retain and recheck supplied root aliases and resolved identities, and read root_manifest via its supplied alias; track worktree/review roots equivalently. Alternatively explicitly reject noncanonical/symlink root aliases at entry and document that bounded restriction. Keep full byte rechecks. Add constructor-level same-byte retarget and stable-alias controls.

title: Global empty-LF EOF gate rejects exact original CRLF physical fragments

whole_original_ranges.original: /Users/adamderickandrade/Desktop/HGM DICTIONARY - TRANSLATION APP/To DO/Formal Courses/ACI Readings In Roman ASCII/C05ReadingASCII.txt

detail: 33 current warned frozen files equal complete byte ranges in reopened physical originals. Their final blank line is CRLF, so split-LF yields b"\r", b""; the unconditional literal_warnings EOF assertion rejects before source-range classification, including within classify_physical itself. The first exact C05 fragment is [177050,178087),1037 bytes; EOF line10. This is an actual frozen-source case, not an inferred new exemption.
minimal_remedy: Separate common warning-name/number/trailing/indent validation from category-specific EOF ownership. Permit original CRLF EOF only under independently verified whole physical byte-range provenance and exact literal empty CRLF tail, preserving all complete-source aliases/ranges. Keep ordinary blank-EOF strict and physical-line fallback narrow; reject changed fragments, whitespace-only fabricated reports, nonempty tails, and unsupported categories. Update report/contract/tests without normalizing source.

title: Valid blank diff context at EOF cannot pass mixed trailing/EOF diagnostics
detail: The actual root bank file is a complete balanced unified diff: ---/+++/@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@ and exactly balanced content. Existing diff_context_lines independently returns {5,8,10}. Git reports trailing whitespace at5/8/10 and new blank line at EOF at10. Line10 is exactly the required single ASCII context marker, not an empty LF line. Global EOF validation rejects it; even bypassing that gate leaves the single-kind ordinary branch rejecting this combination. Actual261-record root manifest has one exact source/copy record, whose full original equals the 2176-byte bank file.
minimal_remedy: Add a bounded complete-diff-context path that validates all reported trailing lines and any EOF line as exact one-space parsed context positions, with exact allowed final tail, and permits this observed mixed warning set. Preserve ordinary empty-LF EOF behavior separately; do not accept arbitrary whitespace EOF, marker-shaped prose, unbalanced hunks, source prints, or unsupported kinds. Preserve this original diff unchanged and test its complete actual bytes plus negatives.
